scope: Independent stdlib recalculation from six frozen folders; no new GPU run, model data or sampling. Explicit expected pairs and variants are independent of result labels. Producer verification and aggregation functions were not imported.
method: ABBA/BAAB ratio recomputed as exp((sum(log(B))-sum(log(A)))/2); geometric per-call times recomputed separately. Exact row keys, variants, rounds, execution arguments, numeric correctness gates, reported exact-decode hashes, memory component sums and current source/fixture hashes checked.
review_limits: PASS denotes audit integrity. All three main experimental primary criteria remain FAIL.
Recorded GPU correctness booleans/hashes were cross-checked, not independently regenerated on hardware by this audit. The independent FP64 references and resource bindings were reviewed in source.
T2048/T8192 repeat one real fixture. Timing measures warm precompressed attention; encoding, cache updates, full inference and model PPL are not measured.
Persistent K/V/metadata sums exclude query/scratch, diagnostics, CPU tensors and GPU register allocations. They are not process peak memory.
Sample-call counts and source ordering do not establish DRAM traffic, hardware scheduling, register pressure or occupancy.
GQA3 reuses K/V but keeps three independent Q/softmax/accumulator states; quality scope remains the represented values of each format.
The v10 primary is a memory/latency tradeoff: <=1.05 of both old and fused FP16 in every session, plus persistent ratio<=0.75. A slower fused FP16 alone cannot produce a positive result.
all_raw_block_metadata_verification: PASS: every raw block including smoke and ragged processes has four slots, exact independent expected pair/variant labels, order and iteration count.
